config_contents.description: The pooled DRN of the four months with a neural correction of EMOS (EMOS fitted per month) and with neighbourhood inputs, February-initialized FMAM (scripts/pooled_benchmark.py, docs/54 section 3g).
config_contents.external_note: EMOS is read from the second stage (neural_ext), which fits it on the same folds and scores it with the same rule (scoring version 2); the pooled DRN is refitted here as the control.

provenance.uncommitted_check: code and configuration files this result depends on

pathway: B: rainfall-distribution models from the raw ensemble, pooled over the months

drn_pooled.name: DRN pooled over the months of a cycle
drn_pooled.estimates: rainfall distribution with a probability of zero (mixture of 3 seeds)
drn_pooled.predictors: the DRN inputs and the month's position in the season (one-hot)
drn_pooled.fitting: one network for the four months (pooled_benchmark.py), otherwise as the DRN

drn_pooled_residual.name: Neural correction of EMOS pooled over the months of a cycle
drn_pooled_residual.estimates: rainfall distribution with a probability of zero (mixture of 3 seeds)
drn_pooled_residual.predictors: the pooled DRN inputs; each month's own EMOS (mean and mean absolute difference) as the base
drn_pooled_residual.fitting: one network for the four months (pooled_benchmark.py) added to the EMOS of each month, starting at zero, with a penalty on the correction

drn_pooled_nbhd.name: DRN pooled over the months, with neighbourhood inputs
drn_pooled_nbhd.estimates: rainfall distribution with a probability of zero (mixture of 3 seeds)
drn_pooled_nbhd.predictors: the pooled DRN inputs and 3x3 / 5x5 neighbourhood means of the ensemble summaries
drn_pooled_nbhd.fitting: one network for the four months (pooled_benchmark.py), otherwise as the DRN

references.incumbent: MVS -> smoothed counts -> climatology blend (published probabilities)

accepted.note: pooled DRN refit, pooled neural correction of EMOS (EMOS per month) and pooled DRN with 3x3/5x5 neighbourhood inputs; 25 members, scoring v2, saved predictions (docs/54 3g)
